findings.value: A seasonal restaurant in a walled garden off Arnold Circus, open since 2004 and serving classic and modern European food. Time Out calls it a garden restaurant and London landmark.

evidence.quote: Rochelle Canteen’s seasonal, daily changing menu is a celebration of all the things we love most.
Our cooking is both classic and modern European, meaning we take influences from Britain and further afield to Europe.
The garden surroundings, walled off from the bustle of surrounding streets
find the door in the brick wall on the south-east side of Arnold Circus
A gorgeous garden restaurant and London landmark, hidden away in the backstreets of Shoreditch

notes: Time Out's review (Leonie Cooper, 3 Mar 2023) gives its postcode as E2 7ES; the registry has E2 7FA (facts aspect to check). Time Out's crowd remarks describe the early days, so they are not used as current crowd.
